messages:
maria: Quick Q — where do we edit PagerDuty ack timeout/escalation windows for the 'inference-degraded' service? It's flapping in staging and paging oncall during batch tests :grimacing:

sam: We keep PD service docs in ops-runbooks (docs/pagerduty.md) — but the actual Escalation Policy lives in PD UI under Services > Inference Platform > Escalation Policy. For infra changes we prefer terraform-pd.

maria: Got it. Do we prefer terraform or manual for a small tweak like changing ack_timeout from 2m -> 10m in staging? Don't want to accidentally touch prod.

kevin: Use terraform for prod. For staging you can change the Escalation Policy manually in PD UI and add a changelog note. For the flapping alerts I'd bump ack_timeout to 10m and add a secondary step to page oncall-rt after 20m.

sam: FYI alerts flow: Grafana -> Alertmanager -> PD integration. If tests are noisy during nightly batches, we usually add a routing rule (label env=staging) or temporarily silence the alert. Also add runbook annotation: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-degraded

maria: Can someone paste the PD service ID and terraform path so I can open a PR if we go terraform route?

kevin: service id: P12345
terraform path: infra/terraform/pagerduty/services/inference_platform.tf

maria: thanks. Also — is weekend escalation different? Want to confirm manager loop timing (don't want to wake a manager for staging noise).

sam: Weekends follow oncall-sre -> oncall-engineering. Manager escalation (manager-loop) is 1h by policy; details in ops-runbooks. I'll add direct links to the doc for you.

pagerduty-bot: [info] Change request received: maria requested ack_timeout change on service P12345. Approvers: @kevin @sam. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-degraded

maria: Pinging @kevin @sam — I'll hold off until someone ACKs and I open the PR.

kevin: ACK. Go ahead and open a PR against infra repo and assign to me.

maria: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/482 — title: "pd: bump ack_timeout for inference_platform to 10m (staging)". Description notes the batch windows and links to alerts dashboard.

sam: LGTM, merge after CI. Also please add a small note on the Grafana alert panel: https://grafana.redwood/d/alerts/inference so we don't forget why timeout changed.

maria: Done, thanks all :tada:
